subject: maths
question: Two tangent segments, PA and PB, are drawn from an external point P to a circle with center O. If ∠ APB=70º, what is the measure of the angle ∠ AOB?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **angle between two tangents** drawn from an external point and the **angle subtended by the line segments joining the points of contact at the center** are **supplementary**.

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠APB = 180º

⇒ ∠AOB + 70º = 180º

⇒ ∠AOB = 180º − 70º = 110º

**∴ The correct answer is 110 º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Center** of the circle = O

**External point** = P

**Tangents** = PA and PB

Angle between tangents ∠APB = 70º

**Formula Used:**

1. The **tangent** at any point of a circle is **perpendicular** to the **radius** through the point of contact (∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90º).

2. The sum of interior angles of a **quadrilateral** is 360º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7460a83ff1f0899086275c49e63cd4a2148a4b02e8120d21e788d860d9d09001.png] 

**Calculations:**

In quadrilateral **OAPB**:

⇒ ∠OAP + ∠APB + ∠OBP + ∠AOB = 360º

⇒ 90º + 70º + 90º + ∠AOB = 360º

⇒ 250º + ∠AOB = 360º

⇒ ∠AOB = 360º − 250º

⇒ ∠AOB = 110º

**∴ The correct answer is 110 º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent Length Property

The lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are always equal (PA = PB).

Cyclic Quadrilateral

The quadrilateral formed by the center, the two points of contact, and the external point (OAPB) is always a cyclic quadrilateral because ∠OAP + ∠OBP = 180º.

Angle Bisector Property

The line joining the external point to the center (OP) bisects the angle between the two tangents (∠APO = ∠BPO).</p
